n6160a78068.headline: Trump puts Taiwan on the tightrope
n6160a78068.summary: An East Asia Forum analysis says Taiwan must navigate multiple pressures under a second Trump presidency. It must balance economic stability with military deterrence amid US–China tensions.
n6160a78068.why: Taiwan hosts much of the world's advanced semiconductor manufacturing, so US–China tensions around the island directly affect global chip supply chains.

n5e60e19a1a.headline: Savannah secures potential $270m loan guarantee for Portugal lithium project
n5e60e19a1a.summary: Germany's export credit agency Euler Hermes has confirmed in a non-binding letter potential eligibility for a loan guarantee of up to $270 million. The loan would fund construction of Savannah's Barroso lithium project in Portugal.
n5e60e19a1a.why: Lithium is a key input for electric vehicle batteries, and export credit support can make development finance for new mines more feasible.

n64a6baac65.headline: Nigeria, France sign MoU to develop mineral value chain
n64a6baac65.summary: The Nigerian government has signed a memorandum of understanding with France to promote and diversify the critical mineral value chain in its solid minerals sector. A ministry spokesperson disclosed the deal.
n64a6baac65.why: Critical minerals are essential inputs for batteries and electronics, so partnerships that develop processing capacity affect global supply.

n9d757697fd.headline: Ferragamo Shares Boosted after Confirmation of 2024 Forecasts
n9d757697fd.summary: Ferragamo shares rose after the Italian luxury group confirmed its full-year profitability forecast. It also announced a likely impairment writedown of 70-90 million euros, which a Milan trader said has only an accounting impact.
n9d757697fd.why: Salvatore Ferragamo is an Italian luxury fashion group, and its guidance signals how the premium goods sector is trading in an uncertain environment.

n598fefda9b.headline: Lawmakers in Georgia's separatist region of Abkhazia reject encouraging Russian investment
n598fefda9b.summary: Lawmakers in Georgia's breakaway region of Abkhazia rejected a bill offering privileges to Russian investors on Tuesday. The vote was reported by the Associated Press.
n598fefda9b.why: Abkhazia is a disputed territory whose investment rules affect foreign capital flows and the region's relations with Russia.

nd6aef0cd2a.headline: Latvian PM suggest “slashing the legs” of Rail Baltica’s costs

nd6aef0cd2a.why: Rail Baltica is a major cross-border rail project in the Baltic states, and cost controls affect public spending and contractor returns.

n0e4855aa00.why: OPEC+ is a group of major oil producers whose output decisions strongly influence global crude supply and prices. Brent and WTI are the main international oil benchmarks.

ncdc546b630.summary: European gas prices rose to this year's highest in November, hovering slightly above $490 per 1,000 cubic meters, based on ICE data from London.

n503a5f50c9.why: Banking resilience is central to credit availability and financial stability, and monetary policy rates shape borrowing costs across West African economies.

n0149a89965.headline: China Curbs Exports of Key Chipmaking Components to US
n0149a89965.summary: Beijing will restrict exports to the US of gallium, antimony and germanium, key semiconductor inputs, citing national security. The move follows Washington's curbs on China's advanced chip production.
n0149a89965.why: Gallium, antimony and germanium are critical materials in semiconductors and electronics, so export controls can disrupt global chip supply chains.
n0149a89965.why_moved: China's export restrictions on key chipmaking materials respond directly to new US curbs on its advanced chip capabilities.

n5e8cf27cda.summary: French lawmakers voted to oust Prime Minister Michel Barnier's government after just three months. Rising bond yields and a spate of bankruptcies are making investors nervous.
n5e8cf27cda.why: France is the euro area's second-largest economy, and its government debt is a key benchmark for eurozone sovereign risk.

n54f139a251.headline: Coles and Woolworths claim Strepsils and Oreos price promotions ‘not illusory’ in new court documents
n54f139a251.summary: Coles and Woolworths have lodged court documents rebutting accusations that their Strepsils and Oreos price promotions misled shoppers. The filings were made in federal court.
n54f139a251.why: Coles and Woolworths are Australia's two largest supermarket chains, and regulatory action on pricing affects their earnings and reputations.

ne033d70f57.summary: Social Democratic leader Kristrun Frostadottir has been tasked with forming a new coalition government in Iceland amid a cost-of-living crisis. She would replace the current conservative-led coalition if successful.
ne033d70f57.why: Government formation determines fiscal and economic policy in Iceland, a small open economy whose policy choices affect its krona and financial markets.

n5ebb36dee3.headline: French lawmakers to hold no-confidence vote against embattled Barnier government on Wednesday
n5ebb36dee3.summary: French lawmakers will debate a no-confidence motion against the Barnier government at 4 p.m. on Wednesday, with a vote expected later that evening. The motion targets Prime Minister Michel Barnier's government.
n5ebb36dee3.why: Political instability in France, the euro area's second-largest economy, affects French government bond yields and budget policy.
n5ebb36dee3.why_moved: A no-confidence vote threatens the government's survival, raising uncertainty over French budget policy and debt sentiment.
